ns2:course.label: Designing and Managing Orgs
ns2:course.description: Understanding of complex organizations; particular attention to ways of dividing work, achieving coordination, and issues connected with change and adaptation. Prerequisite: BADM 310.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Marketing or Business Process Management or Management or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Strategy, Innovation & Entrep major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
